headline: fair_* = sm_* on purpose: the energy paths are smoothed with ENERGY-AWARE string pulling (shortcut accepted only if collision-free and not costlier in the true wind, dense 2 m sampling, same speed policy), the shortest path with plain geometric pulling; both scored in the same field. effects: route_only, speed_only (mostly the 10 -> 18 m/s efficiency gain, not wind), speed_choice_still_air, wind_speed_adaptation (per-segment best speed vs constant max-range speed 18.3 m/s), direction_asym
